name: Corigliano Calabro (Italy)
description: Blue field charged with a white lozenge throughout bearing the municipal seal of Corigliano Calabro (the arms within a blue ring inscribed AUSONIA CIVITAS CORULIANENSIUM).
history: Flag of the former comune of Corigliano Calabro in Calabria, which merged with Rossano on 31 March 2018 to form the new comune of Corigliano-Rossano.

features.role: Corigliano Calabro seal — arms within a ring inscribed AUSONIA CIVITAS CORULIANENSIUM
